body: Founder: 'the midpiano squad types slash gta7 and watches the founder struggle...' -> 'the story so far' -> 'and some live commentary as the founder plays' -> 'emily tail gta7 or whatever' (real instruction to ground it in actual server.log data, not invent it) -> 'as a blog post' -> 'polish'. Checked the real server log before writing the commentary section -- found the real story was funnier than what I'd drafted first: zero Field Offices claimed by anyone, server-wide, and the founder's actual session was a real string of deaths (multiple Husks, Zombie, Spider, 3 Creepers, Enderman, Drowned, Skeleton, and suffocating inside a stationary wall), plus two real /gta7tv broadcast-TV placements. Rewrote the commentary section entirely around the true log instead of the invented Field-Office-claim narrative I'd drafted first. Published: https://okemily.com/blog/mid-piano-presents-the-wall-undefeated/
title: Mid-Piano Presents: The Wall, Undefeated
